reason: This is a feature PR, but it is not just local DDL plumbing: it adds new table-level SQL syntax and a parser keyword/grammar path, updates AST/parser generated files, and changes executor-facing metadata surfaces (`SHOW`/`INFORMATION_SCHEMA`). Parser keyword and DDL syntax changes have broad SQL-compatibility blast radius, and the table metadata/model changes raise cross-version and visibility correctness risk. That is central and risky enough to justify a focused deep review for Blocker/High issues.
